issues.description: Lecture class fields (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors): the UML in problem_statement.md (lines 63-68) shows these attributes as private. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) declares all five attributes as private. The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 4-5) declares two fields (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) as public and does not declare the remaining three attributes. This visibility mismatch may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether to use public fields or private fields with getters/setters, potentially leading to inconsistent implementations or tests that expect encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java so the attribute declarations match the UML and the solution: change 'public String lectureName;' and 'public int numberOfInscribedStudents;' to private, and add the missing private fields 'numberOfGuestStudents', 'numberOfLecturers', and 'numberOfTutors' with the same types. Optionally add a short comment in the template stating that attributes should be private and accessed via getters/setters to avoid confusion.
